title: Edge-graceful and antimagic labelings of all trees with at most 31 vertices: code and data
description:
Code and data for the paper Lee's edge-graceful tree conjecture for all trees with at most 31 vertices, and the zero vertex of an edge-graceful labeling.

Every tree of odd order n ≤ 31 is edge-graceful (Lee's conjecture), and every tree with 3 ≤ n ≤ 31 vertices is antimagic (Hartsfield–Ringel conjecture for trees). For odd n ≤ 27, every internal vertex of every tree is the zero vertex of some edge-graceful labeling, except the ends of the double brooms D(k,m,2), D(k,m,3) and, for n = 9, of D(2,2,4).

The trees are enumerated with gentreeg (nauty 2.9.3), every labeling is written to a certificate and accepted by an independent checker, and the number of trees of every order equals OEIS A000055. The repository contains the search, the checkers, the driver and analysis scripts, the certificates for all trees with at most 21 vertices, the SHA-256 of the certificate of every part, the summaries of all runs and the results of the independent checks. The search is deterministic, so every certificate can be regenerated bit for bit and compared with its hash.
